excerpt.zh: 由于在[revolt_planet.Planet.GetName]上终止了奴役劳动，动乱终于逐渐平息了。现在民众生活应该能够回归正规了吧。
excerpt.en: Thanks to the discontinued use of slave labor on [revolt_planet.Planet.GetName], unrest is beginning to die down. Maybe now life can return to normal.
